# BuildBlock

> BuildBlock manufactures Insulated Concrete Forms (ICFs) for energy-efficient, disaster-resistant residential and commercial construction.

BuildBlock is a leading ICF building systems manufacturer offering concrete form solutions with superior thermal performance, disaster resilience, and long-term energy savings. The company provides comprehensive resources for homebuyers, contractors, and builders implementing ICF construction methods.

## Key Topics

- Insulated Concrete Forms (ICF)
- Energy Efficiency
- Thermal Mass
- Disaster Resistance
- Fire Resistance
- Earthquake Resistance
- Wind Resistance
- R-22 Rating
- Concrete Construction
- EPS Foam Insulation
- Sound Insulation
- Commercial Construction
- Residential Construction
- Building Systems
- Construction Methods

- [Quiet and Comfortable Homes](https://buildblock.com/insulating-concrete-forms-icfs/quiet-and-comfortable): Sound insulation, thermal comfort, and indoor air quality benefits of ICFs
